name: Media Committee
description: Responsible for branding, content creation, and managing MMC’s online presence through engaging promotional materials and social media strategies.

name: Public Relations (PR) Committee
description: Focuses on building strong relationships with stakeholders by coordinating partnerships and organizing impactful public events.

name: Digital Committee
description: Dedicated to technological innovation, ensuring the development, security, and maintenance of MMC’s digital infrastructure.

name: Logistics Committee
description: Manages the operational aspects of MMC, overseeing event logistics, resource allocation, and transportation for seamless project execution.

name: Project Committees
description: Each project within MMC has its own dedicated committee that collaborates closely with the permanent committees to ensure the project’s success through continuous planning and execution.
